title: Dynamics of variability and bias in working memory.
title_zh: 工作记忆中变异性与偏差的动态变化
abstract: Visual working memory performance declines with the quantity of material stored and the duration of its maintenance, but it is disputed whether these constraints are independent or interact. Specifically, different studies have reached contradictory conclusions on whether greater memory load accelerates deterioration of the stored information during retention, a question with implications for storage mechanisms. Meanwhile, prominent models of visual working memory based on stable attractors predict that recall should become increasingly biased toward a fixed set of canonical features with longer retention, but empirical support is mixed. Uncertainty is further exacerbated by limited data, methodological variation, and inconsistent analytical approaches across studies. Moreover, previous studies have not always distinguished response variability from stimulus-specific biases nor considered the possibility of swap errors (intrusions). To address these issues, we conducted six new experiments and reanalyzed data from seven published experiments using consistent analytical methods to examine the effects of set size and delay on variability and bias. Our results show that recall variability increased with longer delays and higher set sizes, consistent with prior findings, and importantly, that these effects did not operate independently: The effect of delay was amplified at higher set sizes. We also observed consistent evidence for systematic biases across stimuli, but unlike variability, bias amplitude did not change with either set size or retention interval. These results support diffusion accounts of visual working memory maintenance, in which variability grows through the accumulation of random error, while challenging stable attractor accounts that predict systematic drift toward canonical values during maintenance. abstract_zh: 视觉工作记忆的表现会随着存储材料的数量和维持时间的延长而下降，但关于这些限制是独立还是相互作用仍存在争议。具体而言，不同研究得出了相互矛盾的结论，关于更大的记忆负荷是否会加速存储信息在保持期间的衰退，这一问题对存储机制具有重要意义。与此同时，基于稳定吸引子的视觉工作记忆模型预测，随着保持时间的延长，回忆会越来越偏向一组固定的典型特征，但经验支持结果不一。由于数据有限、方法多样以及研究间分析方法不一致，导致不确定性进一步加剧。此外，先前的研究并不总是区分响应变异性与刺激特异性偏差，也未考虑交换错误（侵入）的可能性。为解决这些问题，我们开展了六项新实验，并使用一致的分析方法重新分析了七项已发表实验的数据，以检验集合大小和延迟对变异性与偏差的影响。结果显示，回忆变异性随更长延迟和更大集合大小而增加，符合先前发现，并且这些效应并非独立：延迟效应在更大集合大小下被放大。我们还观察到刺激间系统性偏差的一致证据，但与变异性不同，偏差幅度不随集合大小或保持间隔变化。上述结果支持视觉工作记忆维护的扩散模型，即变异性通过随机误差的累积而增长，而挑战预测在维护期间系统性漂移至典型值的稳定吸引子模型。（PsycInfo 数据库记录 (c) 2026 APA，保留所有权利）
